name: ripgrep-ignoreprec-v2
instr:
Our file watcher keeps rebuilding on changes git ignores

Our dev server's file watcher uses the `ignore` crate from this checkout: it builds a `Gitignore` from the repo's top-level .gitignore once, and drops every change event whose path, or a directory above it, is ignored. After we bumped the dependency to this checkout, each build kicks off another one: writes under target/ (target/debug/app.d, target/debug/deps/...), web/dist/ and web/node_modules/ come back as not ignored, although `git check-ignore -v target/debug/app.d` says `/target/` ignores it. The whole point of the crate for us is that the watcher agrees with git about which paths are ignored. Our .gitignore, trimmed:

```
/target/
node_modules/
web/dist/
!web/dist/.gitkeep
*.log
.env
!.env.example
```

The checkout is in /workdir. Could you track down where this actually goes wrong and fix it
there? Please include a regression test, in the tests/ directory of the crate it exercises (say
crates/ignore/tests/repro.rs), that fails on the current code because of this problem (a real test
failure, not an import error) and passes once it's fixed.
Test the reported behaviour, not your patch: it should still pass if the bug gets fixed some other correct
way, so no asserting on source text or on helpers only your fix has. It should run on its own
from a clean checkout with just your test files added.

I doubt I'm the only one hitting this. Anything else that goes through that code is probably
wrong too, so please fix it
